Smart charging of electrical vehicles can help in avoiding congestion and peak load demands in an electrical distribution network. We propose a fully decentralized and fair multi-agent system combined with reinforcement learning called "Decentralised multi-armed bandit (2-armed bandit) based on Thompson sampling"(D-MAB2AB-TS) to control the charging of electrical vehicles under uncertainties.
